_note: Nat_multitask_convnext_llm_tuned: Training-free post-hoc weight-space tuning of Nat_multitask_convnext_base_v3_uncalibrated (no retraining; zero test-set labels used). Five closed-form linear-algebraic and mode-connectivity refinements were applied directly to multitask_net.pt: (1) Basin-aligned weight-space Model Soup blending v3_uncalibrated with seed-aligned Nat_multitask_convnext_base_v2 (cos > 0.99988 on LayerNorm backbone: 0.85 v3 + 0.15 v2 on backbone and disease head to preserve epoch-8 pre-collapse generalisation while reducing SGD variance, and 0.65 v3 + 0.35 v2 on crop head to recover v2's 1.0-weighted crop boundary); (2) Exact LayerNorm-metric coordinate factorisation (absorbing backbone.head.norm scale/shift before head surgery and inverting back at machine precision ~2e-15); (3) Bi-directional subspace disentanglement: projecting 85% of the 54-D crop discriminant subspace out of the disease head weights (reducing max crop-disease cosine from +0.41 to +0.057 to eliminate seen-crop shortcut boosts and unseen-crop repulsions) alongside Marchenko-Pastur bulk-edge shrinkage (threshold 0.6104, 13 supercritical canonical directions) on the crop head; (4) Minority-collapse spectral tempering (exponent 0.35 toward Simplex ETF, reducing singular value condition number from 2.99 to 2.04) followed by tau-normalisation (Kang et al., ICLR 2020: tau_disease=0.80, tau_crop=0.65, compressing disease prototype norm skew from 1.45x to 1.06x) and long-tail class-prior bias damping (retaining 0.15 disease / 0.25 crop centered bias); (5) Compositional logit temperature balancing (scaling crop head by 1.22 and disease head by 0.88, effective crop_weight ~0.58) so reliable species predictions lock Top-1/Top-5 candidates onto valid per-crop diseases.
_result: Weights tuned post-hoc without training; pending inference evaluation.

data._note: Standard DPD evaluation on test_seen (2,000) and test_unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base (convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k) with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175). Backbone weights are an 85/15 LayerNorm-compatible Model Soup of v3_uncalibrated and v2; linear heads incorporate closed-form crop-subspace orthogonalisation, Marchenko-Pastur canonical shrinkage, spectral tempering, tau-normalisation, prior-bias damping, and compositional temperature scaling.

input._note: Standard 256x256 cache with 224x224 center crop for evaluation (identical to parent v3_uncalibrated).

augmentation._note: Inherited from parent Nat_multitask_convnext_base_v3_uncalibrated (no retraining performed; evaluation uses deterministic test transform).

loss._note: Parent v3_uncalibrated trained with crop 0.7 / disease 1.3 and label smoothing 0.1; post-hoc tuning rebalances head norms, removes spurious crop-shortcut directions from W_disease, and applies compositional temperature scaling (1.22 crop / 0.88 disease) directly in multitask_net.pt.

optimizer._note: Inherited from parent v3_uncalibrated (no gradient training run for llm_tuned; weights tuned analytically post-hoc).
optimizer.name: adamw

validation._note: gamma_grid: 0 targets uncalibrated (gamma=0.0) generalised zero-shot evaluation directly, relying on the debiased/orthogonalised head weights rather than post-hoc seen-pair subtraction.

training._note: No training run executed for Nat_multitask_convnext_llm_tuned; weights in multitask_net.pt were derived analytically from parent v3_uncalibrated (8-epoch Stage 2 refit) and basin-aligned v2 (15-epoch Stage 2 refit).

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM) over all 333 pairs via log P(crop) + log P(disease).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA for inference evaluation.
